description.zh: 把速度分成水平与竖直两份看抛体，用向心加速度理解匀速圆周，再用点质量引力积分演示牛顿大炮：水平速度达到约 7.9 km/s 就绕地球转，11.2 km/s 脱离。忽略空气阻力与地球自转。
description.en: Split velocity into horizontal and vertical parts for projectiles, use centripetal acceleration to understand uniform circular motion, then integrate point-mass gravity for Newton’s cannon: about 7.9 km/s circles the Earth and 11.2 km/s escapes. Air drag and Earth rotation are ignored.

formula: R = v² sin2θ / g,  a = v² / r

label.en: A circle needs an inward net force

reason.zh: 第 3 步把匀速圆周的向心加速度 v²/r 与指向圆心的合力对应，剪断绳子后物体沿切线飞出。
reason.en: Step 3 ties the centripetal acceleration v²/r to a net force toward the centre; cut the string and the body leaves along the tangent.

label.en: Treating motion one component at a time

reason.zh: 第 0 步把水平匀速与竖直匀加速分开处理，是速度—时间图中位移公式的二维应用。
reason.en: Step 0 treats horizontal uniform motion and vertical uniform acceleration separately, a two-dimensional use of the displacement ideas from velocity–time graphs.

title.zh: 卫星为什么不会掉下来？
title.en: Why doesn’t a satellite fall down?

ask.zh: 抛体运动可把速度分成水平和竖直两份——水平方向受力吗？竖直方向呢？
ask.en: Projectile motion splits velocity into horizontal and vertical parts — is there a force horizontally? Vertically?

ask.zh: 匀速圆周需要向心加速度——卫星绕地球转，向心力由什么提供？
ask.en: Uniform circular motion needs centripetal acceleration — for a satellite circling Earth, what supplies the centripetal force?

reveal.zh: 卫星水平速度约 7.9 km/s 时，下落的弧度正好跟上地球表面的弯曲，于是绕着地球转而不掉下来；11.2 km/s 就脱离。
reveal.en: At about 7.9 km/s sideways, the satellite's fall curves exactly with Earth's surface, so it circles without landing; 11.2 km/s escapes.

note: Mechanics group follows atlas net-force / work-energy (group "waves").
